# 1 Enoch Chapter 39 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Ge'ez MS | **Section:** Book of Parables

---

**39:1** In those days, holy and chosen children will come down from the highest heaven, and they will intermingle with the children of humanity.

**39:2** In those days, Enoch received books filled with wrath and anger, books of trouble and expulsion — for no mercy will be shown to the wicked, declares the Lord of Spirits.

**39:3** Then a cloud and a great wind swept me up from the earth and carried me to the farthest reaches of heaven.

**39:4** There I saw another vision — the homes of the holy ones and the places where the righteous rest.

**39:5** My eyes saw their homes among the righteous angels, and their resting places with the holy ones. The angels were praying and interceding for humanity, and righteousness poured out before them like a river, and mercy fell like dew upon the earth — and so it will be for them forever and ever.

**39:6** In that same place, my eyes beheld the Elect One — the one who embodies righteousness and faithfulness. Righteousness will flourish in his days, and the righteous and elect will stand before him, beyond all counting, forever and ever.

**39:7** I saw his dwelling place beneath the wings of the Lord of Spirits. All the righteous and chosen before him blazed like torches of fire. Their mouths were full of praise, and their lips gave glory to the name of the Lord of Spirits. Before him righteousness never fails; before him integrity never wavers.

**39:8** I longed to stay in that place. My heart ached for it — because that was where my destiny had always been, before the Lord of Spirits had appointed my path.

**39:9** In those days I praised and glorified the name of the Lord of Spirits with thanksgiving and worship, because he had set me apart for blessing and glory, according to his own good pleasure.

**39:10** For a long time my gaze was fixed on that place. I blessed him and praised him, saying: "Blessed is he — blessed from the beginning and blessed forever. He has no end. Before the world was made he already knew what the world would become, generation after generation. Those who never sleep stand before his glory, blessing, praising, and exalting him, crying out: 'Holy, holy, holy is the Lord of Spirits — his spirits fill all the earth!'"

**39:11** My eyes saw all those who never sleep, standing before him and blessing him, calling out: "Blessed are you, and blessed is the name of the Lord, now and forever!"

**39:12** My face changed — I could not bear to look.

**39:13** Then I saw a multitude without number — thousands of thousands, tens of thousands of tens of thousands — standing before the Lord of Spirits. On all four sides, on all four wings of the Lord of Spirits, I saw still more, beyond counting, standing there.

---

*PNEUMA notes: The vision of the Elect One "under the wings of the Lord of Spirits" (v. 7) is one of the most moving images in the Parables — the sheltered, intimate dwelling of God's chosen agent. The transformation of Enoch's face (v. 12) echoes Moses at Sinai and prefigures the NT transfiguration tradition.*
